```{r config}

# HOW TO CONFIGURE ------------------------------------------------------
# Any chunks below that depend on config options should be cached and use one
# or more sections of the config object as arbitrary additional chunk options.
# By convention, we use the argument name "config" although there is nothing
# special about this name e.g.,
#
#      {r, cache=TRUE, config=config$annotation}
#
# Thereafter, any changes to config options under the "annotation" section will then
# invalidate that chunk's cache -- along with any other chunks that also have
# config$annotation included as a chunk option.
#
config <- lcdbwf:::load_config('config.yaml')

# To keep this Rmd streamlined, much of the text is stored in a different file,
# text.yaml, and accessed via the `text` list after it is loaded here.
text <- yaml::yaml.load_file('text.yaml')

parallel <- config$parallel$parallel
if (config$parallel$parallel){
    register(MulticoreParam(config$parallel$cores))
}
```

In this analysis, we used a version of the annotation where all features (CDSs, UTRs, IGRs, ASs)
were quantified by ``featurecounts``, with the parameter `-O` to allow mapping a read to each of its
overlapping features. This was decided because not allowing a read to be assigned to 2 features would discard
all reads mapping to the gene and UTR, and because that is matching the behavior of the RILseq pipeline.

In the RILseq pipeline, reads are mapped using the function [count_features](https://github.com/asafpr/RILseq/blob/532c13edfe7350e00e3bd44b08a112faba81de93/bin/count_chimeric_reads_per_gene.py#L62),
counting a read in a feature as long as the coordinates overlap.

```{r coldata_setup}
# Set up all of the metadata for the samples and experimental design. Use this
# chunk to modify if needed.
colData <- read.table(params$sampletable, sep='\t', header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
# filter to the samples in the batch
colData <- colData %>%
  filter(batch == 'FMD') %>%
  filter(RNAseq_workflow == 'yes')

# lcdb-wf requires that the first column of the sampletable contains sample
# names. Use that to set the rownames.
rownames(colData) <- colData[,1]
```

```{r dds_initial, cache=TRUE, config=c(config$main, config$toggle$salmon, config$toggle$kallisto)}
# Convert featureCounts gene-level counts into DESeq2 object, and run
# variance-stabiliizing transform.
dds_initial <- lcdbwf:::make_dds(
  list(sampletable=colData, design=~1, subset_counts=TRUE),
  config=config,
  featureCounts=featurecounts_fn,
  parallel=config$parallel$parallel
)
vsd <- varianceStabilizingTransformation(dds_initial, blind=TRUE)
```

## PCA {.tabset}

```{r pca, results='asis', cache=TRUE, config=c(text$qc$pca, config$plotting$covariates_for_plots), dependson='dds_initial'}
dir.create('results', showWarnings = FALSE)
# Plot PCA plots, optionally tabbed with different factors colored, for QC.
lcdbwf:::mdcat(text$qc$pca)

# want custom colors
cols_i <- list(
  'WT_Untagged_Hfq' = '#000000',
  'Hfq_FLAG' = '#000000',
  'Hfq_D9A_FLAG' = '#FA1702',
  'Hfq_R16A_FLAG' = '#CC88f8',
  'Hfq_Y25D_FLAG' = '#6B8FDA',
  'Hfq_K31A_FLAG' = '#0000F5')

for(group in config$plotting$covariates_for_plots){
    lcdbwf:::mdcat('### ', paste(group, sep=", "))

    # the '-' in the group names is preventing setting the colors. Need to change them first
    vsd_pca <- vsd
    vsd_pca@colData[[group]] <- stringr::str_replace(vsd_pca@colData[[group]], '-', '_')

    p <- lcdbwf:::plotPCA.ly(vsd_pca, intgroup=group) +
        scale_color_manual(labels= names(cols_i), values=cols_i)
    print(htmltools::tagList(ggplotly(p)))
    fn <- paste0('results/PCA_by_', group, '.pdf')
    ggsave(fn, plot=p)
    cat(paste0('\n\n- [', fn, '](', fn, ')\n\n'))
}
```

```{r dds_list, cache=TRUE, config=config$main}
# Create a list of dds objects used as the basis for differential expression.
#
# May need substantial editing.
lst <- list(
            'main'=list(
                sampletable=colData,
                design=~group + 0,   # + 0 for the interaction formula
                subset_counts=TRUE
            )
          )
dds_list <- map(lst, lcdbwf:::make_dds, config=config,
  parallel=config$parallel$parallel, featureCounts=featurecounts_fn)

# GTF has Ecocyc gene IDs, that are not in the orgDb,
# need to use the gene_name, but featurecounts did not recognize it
ref <- read.csv(params$mappings,
                sep='\t',
                header=TRUE)

# there is a duplicated gene_id, fix this
# gene_id      gene_name    X__featuretype__
# EG10642      narK         exon
# EG10642      narS         exon
# G0-10699.AS  sdsN.AS      AS
# G0-10699     sdsN         sRNA
# G0-10699     G0-10699     other-ncRNA
# G0-10699.AS  G0-10699.AS  AS

ref[ref$gene_name == 'narS', 'gene_id'] <- 'EG10642-2'
ref[ref$gene_name == 'G0-10699', 'gene_id'] <- 'G0-106992-2'
ref[ref$gene_name == 'G0-10699.AS', 'gene_id'] <- 'G0-106992.AS-2'

# some don't have gene_name, replace it with the gene_id
ref <- ref %>%
    mutate(gene_name = ifelse(gene_name == ' ', gene_id, gene_name))
rownames(ref) <- ref[['gene_id']]

# replace the Ecocyc gene_ids with gene_names that are compatible with OrgDb
dds_list <- lapply(dds_list, function(dds_i) {
                        ids <- rownames(dds_i)
                        newids <- ref[ids, 'gene_name']
                        rownames(dds_i) <- newids
                        return(dds_i)
                })

# that caused some AS that had common_nameID and geneID under the same common name to be duplicated
# they have the same counts, keep only 1st
dds_list <- lapply(dds_list, function(dds_i) {
                        ids <- rownames(dds_i)
                        dups <- duplicated(ids)
                        return(dds_i[!dups,])
                })
```

# Differential expression {.tabset}

Now we perform differential expression analysis for the contrasts listed in the
table below.

Under the table are tabs, one for each contrast. Under each contrast's tab,
there are more tabs for the various output.

```{r results_01, dependson='dds_list', cache=TRUE}
# Perform differential expression testing.
#
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# To take advantage of caching:
#   - create each list in a different chunk
#   - ensure chunk name starts with "results_"
#   - ensure list name starts with "contr_[index]_". The rest of the name will be used
#     as a readable label for each constrast. [index] is an alphanumeric string 
#     (ex: contr_01_* or contr_2b_*) that will be used to sort contrasts for output files.
#     The index string must contain at least 1 character and cannot contain "_"
#
# This will need substantial editing.
#
# See ?make_results for details.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

contr_01_FLAGvsUnFLAG_LFC1 <- lcdbwf:::make_results(
  dds_name="main",
  contrast=c("group", "Hfq-FLAG", "WT_Untagged_Hfq"),
  lfcThreshold=1,
  type="ashr",  # using ashr because need ashr for the interaction, and want to keep consistent
  label="Flagged Hfq WT vs. untagged WT, threshold |log2FC| > 1"
)
```

# Custom volcano plots {.tabset}

```{r custom_volcano, results='asis'}
twocolors_plot_volcano_label <- function(res,
                         fdr_thres=0.1,
                         fd_thres=0,
                         fc_lim=NULL,
                         genes_to_label=NULL,
                         label_column=NULL
                         ){
  # TODO: Add ggrastr option for points
  genes_to_label <- as.character(genes_to_label)
  nna <- sum(is.na(genes_to_label))
  if (nna > 0){
      warning(paste("Removing", nna, "NAs from gene list"))
      genes_to_label <- genes_to_label[!is.na(genes_to_label)]
  }
  # convert res to data frame
  res <- data.frame(res)

  # set color depending on LFC sign, green for + and tomato red for -
  res <- res %>%
    mutate( lfc_color = ifelse(log2FoldChange >= fd_thres, 'darkgreen', 'tomato'))

  # if y limits not specified
  if(is.null(fc_lim)){
    fc_lim <- range(res$log2FoldChange, na.rm=TRUE)
    fc_lim[1] <- floor(fc_lim[1])
    fc_lim[2] <- ceiling(fc_lim[2])
  }

  # get data frame of genes outside plot limits
  up.max <- res[res$log2FoldChange > fc_lim[2],]
  up.max$log2FoldChange <- rep(fc_lim[2], dim(up.max)[1])
  up.max <- data.frame(genes=rownames(up.max), up.max)

  down.max <- res[res$log2FoldChange < fc_lim[1],]
  down.max$log2FoldChange <- rep(fc_lim[1], dim(down.max)[1])
  down.max <- data.frame(genes=rownames(down.max), down.max)

  # get data frame of DE genes
  de.list <- res[res$padj < fdr_thres &
                 !is.na(res$padj) &
                 abs(res$log2FoldChange) >= fd_thres,]
  de.list <- data.frame(genes=rownames(de.list), de.list)

  # get data frame of DE genes outside plot limits
  up.max.de <- up.max[rownames(up.max) %in% rownames(de.list),]
  down.max.de <- down.max[rownames(down.max) %in% rownames(de.list),]

 # create ggplot with appropriate layers
  p <- ggplot(res, aes(log2FoldChange, -log10(padj))) +
    geom_point(col="gray40") + xlim(fc_lim[1], fc_lim[2]) +
    theme_bw() + theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank())

  p <- p + ggplot2::geom_point(data=up.max, col="gray40", pch=2)                 # add points above max y
  p <- p + ggplot2::geom_point(data=down.max, col="gray40", pch=6)               # add points below min y

  p <- p + ggplot2::geom_point(data=de.list, col=de.list[['lfc_color']])                          # add DE points
  p <- p + ggplot2::geom_point(data=up.max.de, col=de.list[['lfc_color']], pch=2)                 # add DE points above max y
  p <- p + ggplot2::geom_point(data=down.max.de, col=de.list[['lfc_color']], pch=6)               # add DE points below min y


  if(!is.null(genes_to_label)){
    # get data frame of genes to be labeled
    if (!is.null(label_column)){
        if (!(label_column %in% colnames(res))){
            stop(paste(label_column, "is not a column in the results object; columns are:", colnames(res)))
        }
        res$gene.labels <- res[,label_column]
    } else {
        res$gene.labels <- rownames(res)
    }

    label.list <- res[res$gene.labels %in% genes_to_label,]
    #label.list <- data.frame(genes=rownames(label.list), label.list)

    # label genes outside limits
    up.max.idx <- rownames(label.list) %in% rownames(up.max)
    down.max.idx <- rownames(label.list) %in% rownames(down.max)

    if(sum(up.max.idx) > 0){
      label.list$log2FoldChange[up.max.idx] <- rep(fc_lim[2], sum(up.max.idx))
    }

    if(sum(down.max.idx) > 0){
      label.list$log2FoldChange[down.max.idx] <- rep(fc_lim[1], sum(down.max.idx))
    }

    # add labels
    p <- p + ggplot2::geom_point(data=label.list, col="black", pch=1, size=3)
    p <- p + ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data=label.list, aes(label=label.list$gene.labels, fontface="italic"),
      box.padding=2, max.overlaps = 30)

  }
  return(p)

}

for (name in names(res_list)){
    dds_i <- dds_list[[res_list[[name]][['dds']] ]]
    res_i <- res_list[[name]][['res']]
    label <- res_list[[name]][['label']]
    genes_to_label <- lcdbwf:::genes_to_label(res_i, n=5, config)
    lcdbwf:::mdcat('## ', label, ' {.tabset}')
    print(twocolors_plot_volcano_label(
      res_i,
      genes_to_label=genes_to_label,
      label_column=config$annotation$label_column))
    fn <- paste0('results/volcano_', name, '.pdf')
    ggsave(fn)
    mdcat('- [', fn, '](', fn, ')')
}
```

# Custom volcano plots, |LFC| > 1 

In the table and plots below, the padj was calculated on |LFC| > 0, but the
genes (dots) are color-coded as **red = padj < 0.1 AND LFC < -1**
and **green = padj < 0.1 AND LFC > 1**.

```{r table_lfc1, results='asis'}
# change the metadata(res)$lfcThreshold to 1, so will calculate the number of genes
# with LFC > 1, while the padj still correspond to the original test with LFC > 0
res_list_LFC1 <- lapply(res_list, function(x) {
                        metadata(x$res)$lfcThreshold <- 1
                        return(x)})

lcdbwf:::folded_markdown(text$results_table, "Help for table")
lcdbwf:::summarize_res_list(res_list_LFC1) %>% datatable
```

## Axes: max among all contrasts {.tabset}

x-axis and y-axis are adjusted to the max among total-RNAseq graphs or RIP-seq graphs.

```{r custom_volcano2, results='asis'}
y_max <- lapply(res_list, function(x) {
                 padjs <- -log10(x[['res']][['padj']])
                 padjs <- padjs[is.finite(padjs)]
                 return(max(padjs, na.rm=T))
  }) %>%
  unlist()

y_lims <- list(
  all = c(0, 1.1*max(y_max))
  ) # add some buffer so the top points are not on the edge

x_min <- lapply(res_list, function(x) {
                 min(x[['res']][['log2FoldChange']], na.rm=T)
  }) %>%
  unlist()
x_max <- lapply(res_list, function(x) {
                 max(x[['res']][['log2FoldChange']], na.rm=T)
  }) %>%
  unlist()

x_lims <- list(
  all = c(min(x_min), max(x_max))
  )

for (name in names(res_list)){
    dds_i <- dds_list[[res_list[[name]][['dds']] ]]
    res_i <- res_list[[name]][['res']]
    label <- res_list[[name]][['label']]
    genes_to_label <- lcdbwf:::genes_to_label(res_i, n=5, config)
    lcdbwf:::mdcat('### ', label, ' {.tabset}')
    print(twocolors_plot_volcano_label(
      res_i,
      genes_to_label=genes_to_label,
      label_column=config$annotation$label_column,
      fd_thres=1) +
      ylim(y_lims[['all']]) + xlim(x_lims[['all']]))
    fn <- paste0('results/volcano_', name, '_colorLFC1_constant_axes.pdf')
    ggsave(fn)
    mdcat('- [', fn, '](', fn, ')')
}
```

# Removing Hfq-FLAG vs. WT-unflagged DE genes from other contrasts {.tabset}

We noticed a large number of genes were differentially expressed between the flagged and unflagged
WT strains, as much as 1/3 to 1/2 of the number of DE genes in other contrasts. 56 genes are DE in
all contrasts, including the WT contrast (see upset plot above).

We decided to return a version of the other contrasts results after removing the significant padj of
the DE genes found in the Hfq-FLAG vs. WT-unflagged contrast, to exclude genes that might be DE because
of the FLAG rather than the mutation. Those genes will be indicated in the exported results XLSX and TSV files.

```{r remove, results='asis'}
# get list of DE genes in WT contrast
res.wt <- res_list[['FLAGvsUnFLAG']][['res']]
de_genes <- res.wt %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(padj < config[['main']][['alpha']]) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene)

# mark those genes as to be excluded in the other contrasts
for (name in names(res_list[ names(res_list) != 'FLAGvsUnFLAG' ])) {
  res <- res_list[[name]]$res
  res$to_exclude_because_DE_in_WTflag <- res$gene %in% de_genes[['gene']]
  res_list[[name]]$res <- res
}

# change the padj for those genes
res_list_sub <- res_list[ names(res_list) != 'FLAGvsUnFLAG' ]
names(res_list_sub) <- paste0(names(res_list_sub), '_minus_WT_DE_genes')

for (name in names(res_list_sub)) {
  res <- res_list_sub[[name]]$res
  res[res$to_exclude_because_DE_in_WTflag == TRUE, 'padj'] <- NA
  res_list_sub[[name]]$res <- res
}
```

```{r summary_sub, results='asis'}
lcdbwf:::folded_markdown(text$results_table, "Help for table")
lcdbwf:::summarize_res_list(res_list_sub) %>% datatable
```

```{r reportresults_sub, results='asis', config=c(text$results_plots, config$toggle$results_diagnostics, config$plotting$diagnostics_results_names), dependson='assemble_variables', cache=TRUE}
# First level of tabs will be labels of results; second level will be different
# output (MA plot, volcano plot, etc)
lcdbwf:::build_results_tabs(res_list_sub, dds_list, config, text)
```

# Custom volcano plots {.tabset}

```{r custom_volcano_sub, results='asis'}
for (name in names(res_list_sub)){
    dds_i <- dds_list[[res_list_sub[[name]][['dds']] ]]
    res_i <- res_list_sub[[name]][['res']]
    label <- res_list_sub[[name]][['label']]
    genes_to_label <- lcdbwf:::genes_to_label(res_i, n=5, config)
    lcdbwf:::mdcat('## ', label, ' {.tabset}')
    print(twocolors_plot_volcano_label(
      res_i,
      genes_to_label=genes_to_label,
      label_column=config$annotation$label_column))
    fn <- paste0('results/volcano_minus_FLAG_genes_', name, '.pdf')
    ggsave(fn)
    mdcat('- [', fn, '](', fn, ')')
}
```

```{r upsetplots_sub, results='asis', eval=length(res_list)>1, config=config$annotation, dependson='selections'}
lcdbwf:::plot_upsets(res_list_sub, label_column=config$annotation$label_column)
```



# Exported results

Here is a TSV file that can be opened in Excel, following the same format than the RILseq output files. It
also contains per sample the raw and normalized counts, and per contrast the LFC and p-adjusted (FDR) values:

```{r}
cat(paste0(
'\n\n[results/reformated_results.tsv](', 
  'results/reformated_results.tsv)\n\n'))
```



```{r rilseq_formated}
# Want to match the RILseq excel output files. Need the columns then sort by position:
rilcols <- c('Geneid', 'Chr', 'Start', 'End', 'Strand', 'Length', 'Type')

# raw and normalized counts
df_raw <- counts(dds_list[['main']])
colnames(df_raw) <- paste0('raw_counts_', colnames(df_raw))
df_norm <- counts(dds_list[['main']], normalized=TRUE)
colnames(df_norm) <- paste0('normalized_counts_', colnames(df_norm))
df_cnts <- cbind(df_raw, df_norm) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column('Geneid')

# get genes meta
gtf_ref <- read.csv(params$gtf,
                sep='\t', header=FALSE)
names(gtf_ref) <- c('Chr', 'source', 'Type', 'Start', 'End', 'score', 'Strand', 'na', 'description')
gtf_ref[['Geneid']] <- lapply(gtf_ref[['description']], function(x) {
                               gsub(' gene_name ', '', strsplit(x, ';')[[1]][[2]])
                               }) %>% unlist()
# remove duplicate gene names
gtf_ref <- gtf_ref[!duplicated(gtf_ref[['Geneid']]),]
gtf_ref[['Length']] <- gtf_ref[['End']] - gtf_ref[['Start']]

# add gene meta
df <- merge(gtf_ref[rilcols], df_cnts, by='Geneid') %>%
  arrange(Start, End)

# add LFCs and padjs
for (nm in names(res_list)) {
  df <- merge(df,
    as.data.frame(res_list[[nm]][['res']][c('gene', 'log2FoldChange', 'padj')]),
    by.x='Geneid', by.y='gene', sort=FALSE, all.y=TRUE) %>%
    rename_at(vars(c('log2FoldChange', 'padj')), ~ paste0(c('log2FoldChange', 'padj'), '_', nm))
}
 write.table(df, file='results/reformated_results.tsv', row.names=FALSE, sep='\t', quote=FALSE)
```


```{r excel, results='asis'}
lcdbwf:::exported_excel(res_list, dds_list, file='results/consolidated_results.xlsx')

cat(paste0(
  '\n\nHere is a single Excel file with one worksheet for each contrast: [',  
  'results/consolidated_results.xlsx](results/consolidated_results.xlsx)\n\n'
))
```



Alternatively, the files below are TSVs that can be opened in Excel or used
progammatically with downstream tools:

```{r write_output, results='asis'}
# Write out files for full and each selection, and create a link to them in the
# HTML generated by this RMarkdown.
tbl <- lcdbwf:::exported_tsvs(res_list)
knitr::kable(tbl, row.names=FALSE)
```

```{r combined_rds, cache=TRUE, dependson='assemble_variables'}
obj <- lcdbwf:::compose_results(res_list_sub, dds_list)
saveRDS(obj, file='combined.Rds')
```
